privateMempoolDashboardImport.excludedReason: OpenBitcoin monthly pool history is already in the local master; Mempool pool shares are weekly hashrate estimates and are not mixed into the monthly block-count series.

openBitcoinUtxoFlowImport.formula: utxo_created_count(t) = utxo_count_eod(t) - utxo_count_eod(t-1) + utxo_spent_count(t). On dates without an end-of-day block observation, carry forward only the prior UTXO state; OBM spent count must be zero on those dates. Counts include spendable outputs and exclude provably unspendable outputs under OBM definitions.

bitviewHodlAgePercentageImport.source: Private Bitview UTXO age cohorts plus Bitcoin daily supply
bitviewHodlAgePercentageImport.licenseNote: Private local research only. No separate reuse license for hosted Bitview data was identified; public redistribution and public dashboard display are not cleared.
bitviewHodlAgePercentageImport.formula: For each UTC day and age threshold: 100 * Bitview spendable UTXO supply above the age threshold / Bitcoin total supply. Exact Bitview cohort methodology is provisional; input series and dates are retained without interpolation.
